answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral in an escrow, so creating aliases does not create cost-free voting power. When k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated-evidence penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to their aggregate capital loss; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery from offsetting that loss. The nebula may forge many identities, but none can evade shared-risk accounting; juniper nodes can verify the correlation before slashing.
